premises.text: Large companies lack information on their suppliers' environmental sustainability
premises.evidence_span: companies have to contract with suppliers for everything from screws to leather to paper, but they don't have almost any information on their suppliers' environmental sustainability

premises.text: Consumer shareholders and the media are increasingly focused on supply chain sustainability
premises.evidence_span: consumer shareholders and the media are increasingly paying attention to supply chain sustainability problems

premises.text: Consulting alone cannot meet the critical need for supply chain sustainability management
premises.evidence_span: a critical need could not be met with just a consulting approach

premises.text: An integrated platform can help companies manage supply chain sustainability and risk
premises.evidence_span: first truly integrated platform that helps companies understand and manage their supply chain sustainability, as well as evaluate supply chain risk

premises.text: Suppliers can improve their sustainability practices through feedback from buyers
premises.evidence_span: this helps them. Like, in this case, once Space Lee Sprockets knows where it stands and what's possible, it will be incentivized to improve

premises.text: A unified scorecard library can reduce RFP fatigue for companies
premises.evidence_span: unified scorecard library that fixes the RFP fatigue problem

premises.text: Sustainability reporting is becoming more prevalent among Fortune 500 companies
premises.evidence_span: Fortune 500 company sustainability reporting has gone from 20% to 57% just between 2010 and 2011

value.text: Companies can avoid environmental scandals and improve sustainability through better supplier management
value.evidence_span: they will know exactly which suppliers to use. And they'll know that they won't have to deal with environmental disaster headlines

notes: No traction metrics or external validation included.
